rationale: The description identifies sales engagement, routine task automation, CRM syncing, and opportunity management as conventional workflow functions; next-best-action wording does not establish AI.
evidence_spans: Salesloft automates the manual tasks that hold you back and gives you the next best action to propel deals forward. Start and run your entire day in a single app while all your activity is automatically synced back to the CRM. Manage opportunities from creation to close and expand strategic accounts.
